{'Last weekend Apple TV unveiled a number of announcements at San Diego Comic-Con, including the surprising reveal of a Season 4 release date for Silo.': '上週末 Apple TV 在聖地牙哥動漫展上公布多項消息，當中包括《Silo》（《末世戰疫》）第四季的上線日期，屬意外驚喜。'}

{'Silo Season 4 will debut in Summer 2027 and will be its final season.': '《Silo》第四季將於 2027 年夏季首播，並會是最終季。'}

{'Silo Season 3 is currently streaming (watch here), with new episodes dropping weekly through September 4.': '《Silo》第三季現正播映中（可按此觀看），新集數將每週更新，一直播至 9 月 4 日。'}

{'Alongside updates on other sci-fi series, Apple delivered an unexpected surprise for Silo fans at San Diego Comic-Con this past weekend.': '上週末在聖地牙哥動漫展，除了公布其他科幻劇集的進展外，Apple 亦為《Silo》粉絲帶來意想不到的消息。'}

{'Silo Season 4 is set to premiere next summer and will bring the series to a close.': '《Silo》第四季將於明年夏天播出，並為整部劇集劃上句號。'}

{'Below is the announcement Apple TV shared on X (formerly Twitter):': '以下為 Apple TV 於 X（前稱 Twitter）發布的公告：'}

{'In the streaming era, multi-year gaps between seasons of a show have become the norm, particularly for expensive sci-fi productions like Silo.': '在串流平台年代，一套劇集新一季相隔多年才回歸已成常態，對像《Silo》這類高成本科幻製作尤其如此。'}

{'However, Apple has been accelerating the return of some of its series by ordering additional seasons early on. For Silo, Seasons 3 and 4 were developed and filmed back-to-back.': '不過 Apple 一直透過提早預訂續季，加快部分劇集的回歸速度。以《Silo》為例，第三、四季是同步籌備，並背靠背連續拍攝。'}

{'We still have six more weeks of new Silo to look forward to. However, viewers won’t have to wait long after this season wraps for Season 4.': '我們仍有六星期新一集《Silo》可看。不過今季播完後，觀眾毋須等待太久便可迎來第四季。'}

{'What do you think of Silo Season 3 so far? Let us know in the comments.': '你覺得《Silo》第三季至今如何？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。'}

{'Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can get it at a discounted rate as part of an Apple One bundle.': 'Apple TV 月費為 12.99 美元，或可透過 Apple One 組合享優惠價格。'}

  • {'iPhone MagSafe car mount': 'iPhone 磁吸車用支架'}
  • {'10-year AirTag battery case': '10 年續航 AirTag 電池保護殼'}
  • {'100W USB-C fast charger': '100W USB-C 快速充電火牛'}
  • {'AirTag 2 (1-pack / 4-pack)': 'AirTag 2（1 個裝／4 個裝）'}
